mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing methadone plasma concentrations and prolonging opioid effects; turmeric also has mild antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties.
action: Monitor for signs of methadone toxicity (excessive sedation, respiratory depression); consider increased INR monitoring if patient is also on warfarin; counsel patient on consistent turmeric dosing and report symptoms promptly.
